## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the integration check through `bin/aff`, then the orchestra package, boundary, verdict, project-field, store, and commit checks.

## Approach

Run the seven acceptance commands. The first goes through `bin/aff check`, `bin/aff close-batch`, and `bin/aff verdict`. The others run the orchestra tests and both stores' `validate`. If a command fails, report the output. Do not add a feature in this task.
